series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 5 Consumer Trends for 2017
notes: First archived 2016-11-19. Each trend names a 'Parent mega-trend' (recorded as section, lowercase as printed). Labels are printed on two lines in the page (e.g. 'VIRTUAL EXPERIENCE / ECONOMY'). target_year 2017 from the title. The paid 2017 Trend Report is not captured.

entries.label: VIRTUAL EXPERIENCE ECONOMY
entries.quote: In 2017, the Experience Economy will gain a new dimension: that of the VIRTUAL EXPERIENCE ECONOMY.
entries.subject: Virtual and augmented reality experiences as status
entries.note: Dek: '2017's newest status symbol: digital experiences.'

entries.label: WORLDS APART
entries.quote: purposeful brands will find renewed opportunities in helping people understand their changing relationship to home
entries.subject: Brands responding to nationalism vs. globalism
entries.note: Two sub-groups named: NEW GLOBAL CITIZENS and NATION NURTURERS.

entries.label: INCOGNITO INDIVIDUALS
entries.quote: That’s why 2017 will see opportunities for brands, products and services that enable INCOGNITO INDIVIDUALS to be free.
entries.subject: Anonymity and bias-free services

entries.label: CAPACITY CAPTURE
entries.quote: Which is why, in 2017 smart brands will broaden their thinking around sustainability and turn their attention to CAPACITY CAPTURE.
entries.subject: Monetizing spare capacity and eliminating waste

entries.label: BIG BROTHER BRANDS
entries.quote: Customer expectations around these intertwined basic needs will reach new heights in 2017.
entries.subject: Voice and AI assistants that know the user
entries.note: Preceded by 'Convenience. Seamlessness. Relevance.' Dek: 'But this time, they'll be welcomed!' Section cites Tractica: digital virtual assistant users from 390 million (2015) to 1.8 billion worldwide by 2021; third-party forecast, not recorded as metric.
